import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

headers = { 'Referer': "SOME_STRING_VALUE" }

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/panels?project_id=SOME_STRING_VALUE&route=SOME_STRING_VALUE", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
